title: Enrollment-Timing Points on the Riverbend Self-Pay Maternity & Delivery Package
content:
Package term of Good Faith & Price Estimates: a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery enrollment made late in the pregnancy adds percentage points to the enrollment deposit percentage.

**Term.** The enrollment lead days run from the scheduling date of the estimate to the expected delivery date, the scheduling date not counted and the delivery date counted. Fewer than 112 enrollment lead days add fifteen percentage points (15); 112 to 167 add five (5); 168 or more add none, an expected delivery date on or before the scheduling date counting as zero lead days. The points are added to the package's deposit percentage before that percentage is applied.

| Enrollment lead days | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 111 (a delivery date on or before the scheduling date counts as 0) | 15 |
| 112 to 167 | 5 |
| 168 or more | none |

Edges (hypothetical): 111 lead days, 15 points; 112, 5 points; 167, 5 points; 168, none.
